endorsements.name: Simone Paganessi
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-13881
endorsements.description: A flaw was found in Keycloak Admin API. This vulnerability allows an administrator with limited privileges to retrieve sensitive custom attributes via the /unmanagedAttributes endpoint, bypassing User Profile visibility settings.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.1, 2.7)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Simone Paganessi
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-6946
endorsements.description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the management interface of WatchGuard Firebox appliances via the IPS configuration. An authenticated remote attacker with administrator privileges could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the Firebox management ninterface of another management user.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 4.8)
